guide:
0.00–1.33 s: Start from exact neutral, settle into the rhythm, and nod.
1.33–14.67 s: Larger lifted forward-back foot reaches with salsa accents.
14.67–28.00 s: Left-facing salsa steps and visible neck rhythm.
28.00–41.33 s: Reverse the basic reach with alternating lifted feet.
41.33–54.67 s: Right-facing lifted steps and return to neutral heading.
54.67–56.00 s: Plant both feet, soften the head motion, and return to exact neutral.
